66:11: This is an example that God has given to the believers, that they will not be harmed by mixing with the disbelievers if they are in need of them, as God the Almighty says: “Let not the believers take the disbelievers as allies rather than the believers. And whoever does that has nothing to do with God, unless you fear them out of fear.” Qatada said: Pharaoh was the most rebellious and disbelieving of the people on earth, but by God, his wife’s disbelief did not harm her when she obeyed her Lord, so that they may know that God the Almighty is a just judge who does not punish anyone except for his sin. Ibn Jarir said: Ismail bin Hafs Al-Abli told us, Muhammad bin Ja’far told us, on the authority of Sulayman Al-Taymi, on the authority of Abu Uthman Al-Nahdi, on the authority of Sulayman, who said: Pharaoh’s wife was being tortured in the sun, and when he turned away from her, the angels would shade her with their wings, and she would see her house in Paradise. Then he narrated it on the authority of Muhammad bin Ubayd Al-Maharibi, on the authority of Asbat bin Muhammad, on the authority of Sulayman Al-Taymi, with this chain of transmission. Then Ibn Jarir said: Yaqub bin Ibrahim told me, Ibn Ulayyah told us, on the authority of Hisham Al-Dastawai, on the authority of Al-Qasim bin Abi Bazza, who said: The wife of Pharaoh used to ask who had won. She would be told: Moses and Aaron have won. She would say: I believe in the Lord of Moses and Aaron. So Pharaoh sent to her and said: Look for the biggest rock you can find. If she sticks to what she said, throw it on her, but if she changes her mind, then she is my wife. So when they came to her, she raised her eyes to the sky and saw her house in Paradise. So she stuck to what she said, her soul was taken out, and the rock was thrown on a body that had no soul. So her saying, My Lord, build for me a house near You in Paradise, the scholars said: She chose the neighbor before the house. Something like that has been reported in a hadith with a chain of transmission traceable to the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him): And save me from Pharaoh and his deeds, meaning, deliver me from him, for I disavow his deeds to You. And save me from the wrongdoing people. This woman is Asiya bint Muzahim, may God be pleased with her. Abu Jaafar Al-Razi narrated on the authority of Al-Rabi’ bin Anas on the authority of Abu Al-Aliyah who said: The faith of Pharaoh’s wife preceded the faith of Pharaoh’s treasurer’s wife. She sat combing Pharaoh’s daughter’s hair and the comb fell from her hand. She said: Cursed is he who disbelieves in God! Pharaoh’s daughter said to her: Do you have a lord other than my father? She said: My Lord and the Lord of your father and the Lord of all things is God. Pharaoh’s daughter slapped her and beat her and told her father. Pharaoh sent for her and said: Do you worship a lord other than me? She said: Yes, my Lord and your Lord and the Lord of all things is God, and Him I worship. So Pharaoh tortured her and fixed pegs for her, bound her hands and feet, and sent snakes around her. She remained like that. Then one day he came to her and said: Why don’t you desist? She said: My Lord and your Lord and the Lord of all things is God. He said to her: I will slaughter your son in your mouth if you do not do it. She said to him: Do what you will. So he slaughtered her son in her mouth, and the spirit of her son gave her good report and said to her: Be of good cheer, mother, for you have such and such a reward from God. So she was patient. Then Pharaoh came to her another day and said the same to her, and she said the same to him. So he slaughtered her other son in her mouth, and his spirit gave her good report as well and said to her: Be patient, mother, for you have such and such a reward from God. He said: Pharaoh’s wife heard the words of the spirit of her eldest son, then the younger, so Pharaoh’s wife believed. God took the spirit of Pharaoh’s treasurer’s wife, and removed the veil from her reward, status, and honor in Paradise for Pharaoh’s wife until she saw. Her faith, certainty, and belief increased, so God informed Pharaoh of her faith, and he said to the assembly: What do you know of Asiya bint Muzahim? So they praised her, and he said to them: She worships someone other than me. They said to him: Kill her. So he fixed pegs for her and bound her hands and feet. Then Asiya called upon her Lord and said: My Lord, build for me a house near You in Paradise. It so happened that Pharaoh came to her, and she laughed when she saw her house in Paradise. Pharaoh said: Do you not marvel at her madness? We torture her while she laughs. So God took her soul in Paradise, may God be pleased with her. God the Almighty said: And Mary, the daughter of Imran, who guarded her chastity, meaning she protected and preserved it. Chastity is purity and freedom. Then We breathed into her of Our spirit, meaning by means of the angel, who was Gabriel. God sent him to her and he appeared to her in the form of a human being. God the Almighty commanded him to blow into the pocket of her garment with his mouth. The breath descended and entered her vagina, and from him came the conception of Jesus, peace be upon him. For this reason God the Almighty said: Then We breathed into her of Our spirit, and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures, meaning in His decree and law. And she was of the devoutly obedient. Imam Ahmad said: Yunus told us, Dawud ibn Abi al-Furat told us, on the authority of Alba’, on the authority of Ikrimah, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, who said: The Messenger of God (blessings and peace of God be upon him) drew four lines on the ground and said: Do you know what these are? They said: God and His Messenger know best. The Messenger of God (blessings and peace of God be upon him) said: “The best women of the people of Paradise are: Khadijah bint Khuwaylid, Fatimah bint Muhammad, Mary bint Imran, and Asiyah bint Muzahim, the wife of Pharaoh.” It has been proven in the two Sahihs from the hadith of Shu’bah from Amr ibn Murrah from Murrah al-Hamadani from Abu Musa al-Ash’ari that the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said: “Many men attained perfection, but none attained perfection among women except Asiyah, the wife of Pharaoh, Maryam, the daughter of Imran, and Khadijah bint Khuwaylid. The superiority of Aisha over other women is like the superiority of tharid over all other foods.” We have mentioned the chains of transmission of these hadiths, their wordings, and the discussion of them in the story of Jesus, son of Mary, peace be upon them, in our book Al-Bidayah wa’l-Nihayah, all praise and thanks be to God. We have also mentioned what was reported in the hadith that she and Asiyah bint Muzahim, among his wives, will be in Paradise when God, the Most High, says, married women and virgins, at the end of the interpretation of Surah At-Tahrim, all praise and thanks be to God.

So Pharaoh tortured her and fixed pegs for her, bound her hands and feet, and sent snakes around her. She remained like that. Then one day he came to her and said: Why don’t you desist? She said: My Lord and your Lord and the Lord of all things is God. He said to her: I will slaughter your son in your mouth if you do not do it. She said to him: Do what you will. So he slaughtered her son in her mouth, and the spirit of her son gave her good report and said to her: Be of good cheer, mother, for you have such and such a reward from God. So she was patient. Then Pharaoh came to her another day and said the same to her, and she said the same to him. So he slaughtered her other son in her mouth, and his spirit gave her good report as well and said to her: Be patient, mother, for you have such and such a reward from God. He said: Pharaoh’s wife heard the words of the spirit of her eldest son, then the younger, so Pharaoh’s wife believed. God took the spirit of Pharaoh’s treasurer’s wife, and removed the veil from her reward, status, and honor in Paradise for Pharaoh’s wife until she saw. Her faith, certainty, and belief increased, so God informed Pharaoh of her faith, and he said to the assembly: What do you know of Asiya bint Muzahim? So they praised her, and he said to them: She worships someone other than me. They said to him: Kill her. So he fixed pegs for her and bound her hands and feet. Then Asiya called upon her Lord and said: My Lord, build for me a house near You in Paradise. It so happened that Pharaoh came to her, and she laughed when she saw her house in Paradise. Pharaoh said: Do you not marvel at her madness? We torture her while she laughs. So God took her soul in Paradise, may God be pleased with her. God the Almighty said: And Mary, the daughter of Imran, who guarded her chastity, meaning she protected and preserved it. Chastity is purity and freedom. Then We breathed into her of Our spirit, meaning by means of the angel, who was Gabriel. God sent him to her and he appeared to her in the form of a human being. God the Almighty commanded him to blow into the pocket of her garment with his mouth. The breath descended and entered her vagina, and from him came the conception of Jesus, peace be upon him. For this reason God the Almighty said: Then We breathed into her of Our spirit, and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures, meaning in His decree and law. And she was of the devoutly obedient. Imam Ahmad said: Yunus told us, Dawud ibn Abi al-Furat told us, on the authority of Alba’, on the authority of Ikrimah, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, who said: The Messenger of God (blessings and peace of God be upon him) drew four lines on the ground and said: Do you know what these are? They said: God and His Messenger know best. The Messenger of God (blessings and peace of God be upon him) said: “The best women of the people of Paradise are: Khadijah bint Khuwaylid, Fatimah bint Muhammad, Mary bint Imran, and Asiyah bint Muzahim, the wife of Pharaoh.” It has been proven in the two Sahihs from the hadith of Shu’bah from Amr ibn Murrah from Murrah al-Hamadani from Abu Musa al-Ash’ari that the Prophet (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said: “Many men attained perfection, but none attained perfection among women except Asiyah, the wife of Pharaoh, Maryam, the daughter of Imran, and Khadijah bint Khuwaylid. The superiority of Aisha over other women is like the superiority of tharid over all other foods.” We have mentioned the chains of transmission of these hadiths, their wordings, and the discussion of them in the story of Jesus, son of Mary, peace be upon them, in our book Al-Bidayah wa’l-Nihayah, all praise and thanks be to God. We have also mentioned what was reported in the hadith that she and Asiyah bint Muzahim, among his wives, will be in Paradise when God, the Most High, says, married women and virgins, at the end of the interpretation of Surah At-Tahrim, all praise and thanks be to God.
